introHtml: Custom cafe mugs with a spoon combine the convenience of a built-in stirring tool with the comfort of a full-size mug. Ideal for office breakrooms or client gifts, these mugs save the hassle of hunting for a spoon. Available in ceramic or stoneware, they can be imprinted with your logo using full-color or screen printing. Choose from a variety of colors and capacities to match your brand.
